latest_release.body:
🚀 RLinf v0.4 is here. Reinforcement learning steps out of simulation and into agile control of the physical world.

v0.3 connected the path from simulation to real robots. v0.4 is the step toward deploying embodied RL at real-world scale. The release rebuilds the stack around three pillars: a modular real-robot system, high-efficiency real-robot algorithms, and full-modality models on a heterogeneous compute base.

- 🧩 **Modular real-robot system** (`rlinf.robotics`): arms, dexterous hands, cameras, mobile bases, and teleoperation devices become composable blocks. Hardware drivers are fully decoupled from task logic, so changing a robot body, a configuration, or a cross-node deployment does not require changes to task or policy code.
- ⚡ **Real-robot SOTA post-training**: representation-decoupled online RL (RLT), label-free self-supervised offline RL (STEAM), on-policy distillation (OPD) that reaches 96%+ success in 30 steps, and asynchronous real-time control (RTC) that compresses inference wait to about 2 ms. Together they address expensive real-robot samples, costly labels, and inference stutter.
- 🌐 **Full-modality models**: a PyTorch-native OpenPI (π₀ / π₀.₅) rewritten to match official JAX numerics operator by operator; NVIDIA Cosmos3, FastWAM, π₀-FAST, Evo-1, and MolmoAct2; and the first extension of RL to SD3 / Wan2.2 visual generation.
- 🤝 **Eight accelerator backends and the open ecosystem**: Kunlunxin, Biren, MetaX, and Intel XPU join the stack. Huawei Ascend and Moore Threads reach up to 2.78× throughput, with convergence aligned to A100. RLinf joins the PyTorch Ecosystem, ships as the RL training engine in NVIDIA Isaac Lab v3.0, and publishes joint practices with SGLang and AMD.

Training and evaluation recipes covered by this release are validated for correctness and reproducibility (see the test results at the end).

### Embodied

#### 1. Real World

A unified robot interface decouples hardware from tasks. Arms, end-effectors, cameras, and bases compose freely. The release adds three real-robot platforms and a full dual-arm / single-arm collect–train–deploy toolchain.

**Robot architecture:**

- **Modular real-robot interface** (`rlinf.robotics`): drivers, task definitions, and environment wrappers are decoupled. Arms, dexterous hands / grippers, multi-view cameras, and mobile bases are addressed by one hierarchy. Swapping a driver or a cross-node topology does not require task or policy changes. Links: [Robot Interface](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/robotics.html) ｜ [Robot Architecture](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/robotics_architecture.html) ｜ [Add a Robot](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/extending/new_robot.html)

**Platforms and training pipelines:**

- **Dual-arm Franka**: PICO VR bimanual teleoperation, per-arm HG-DAgger, and native PyTorch OpenPI π₀.₅ dual-arm SFT and deployment. Links: [Dual Franka PICO DAgger](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/dual_franka_pico_dagger.html) ｜ [Dual Franka OpenPI](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/dual_franka_openpi_pytorch.html)
- **Single-arm Franka**: a Qwen-VL real-world reward model, depth capture, smooth intervention, online DAgger writes into LeRobot episodes, and LeRobot dataset merge / filter tools. Link: [Real-World Reward Model](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/franka_reward_model.html)
- **New platforms**: dual-arm YAM (PICO VR teleoperation and LeRobot collection), AgileX Piper, and SO-101. Links: [AgileX Piper](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/piper.html) ｜ [SO-101](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/so101.html)

RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI

RLinf is a flexible and scalable open-source RL infrastructure designed for Embodied and Agentic AI. The 'inf' in RLinf stands for `Infrastructure`, highlighting its role as a robust backbone for next-generation training. It also stands for `Infinite`, symbolizing the system’s support for open-ended learning, continuous generalization, and limitless possibilities in intelligence development.
## What's NEW! - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports RL on π₀.₅ in [GenieSim](https://github.com/AgibotTech/genie_sim) with PPO and GRPO. Doc: [RL with GenieSim](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/geniesim.html). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports SO-101 joint-space demonstration collection, OpenPI π₀.₅ supervised fine-tuning, and local evaluation. Doc: [SO-101](docs/source-en/rst_source/examples/embodied/so101.rst). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports Psi0 VLA and the SIMPLE humanoid simulator. Docs: [Psi0](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/psi0.html), [SIMPLE](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/evaluations/guides/simple.html). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports [PhyAI](https://github.com/mingti-org/phyai) as an in-process rollout backend for π₀.₅ PPO training on LIBERO, including hot weight synchronization. Doc: [PhyAI rollout backend](docs/source-en/rst_source/guides/rollout-engines/phyai.rst). - [2026/10] 🎉 RLinf v0.4 is released, taking RL out of simulation and into agile control of the physical world. Highlights: a modular real-robot system (`rlinf.robotics`), real-robot SOTA post-training algorithms (RLT, STEAM, OPD, RTC), full-modality models (native PyTorch OpenPI π₀ / π₀.₅, Cosmos3, FastWAM, π₀-FAST, Evo-1, MolmoAct2, SD3 / Wan2.2), and eight accelerator backends. Release notes: [RLinf v0.4](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/resources/release_v0.4.html). - [2026/10] 🎉 RLinf introducing **CEL** (Collective Experience Learning): robot fleets improve a shared policy from their own deployment experience without additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions, validated on up to 96 real robots across 5 real-world tasks. ## Key Features RLinf has high flexibility to support diverse RL training workflows (PPO, GRPO, SAC and so on), while hiding the complexity of distributed programming. Users can easily scale RL training to a large number of GPU nodes without modifying code, meeting the increasing demand of computation for RL training. The high flexibility allows RLinf to explore more efficient scheduling and execution. The hybrid execution mode for embodied RL achieves up to **2.434×** throughput compared to existing frameworks. ### Training and Inference Engines RLinf updates models with a training engine and runs rollout and evaluation with an inference engine. FSDP adapts quickly to new models and algorithms, and Megatron-LM and Megatron-Bridge are built for large-scale training. Agentic AI includes reasoning tasks such as math and VQA. PhyAI and ApxInf currently support π₀.₅ only.

## 核心特性 RLinf具有高度灵活性，可支持多种强化学习训练工作流（PPO、GRPO、SAC等），同时隐藏了分布式编程的复杂性。用户无需修改代码即可轻松将强化学习训练扩展至大量GPU节点，满足强化学习训练日益增长的计算需求。 这种高灵活性使 RLinf 能够探索更高效的调度与执行模式。在具身强化学习中，混合执行模式的吞吐量可达现有框架的 **2.434** 倍。 ### 训练与 Rollout 引擎 RLinf 用训练引擎更新模型，用 Rollout 引擎执行 rollout 和评测。FSDP 能快速适配新模型和新算法，Megatron-LM 和 Megatron-Bridge 面向大规模训练。智能体一栏也涵盖数学、VQA 等推理任务。PhyAI 和 ApxInf 目前仅支持 π₀.₅。

## 快速开始 **安装步骤：** 请参考我们的[安装指南](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/rst_source/start/installation.html)安装RLinf。鉴于具身强化学习的环境配置较为复杂，我们推荐直接使用我们提供的Docker镜像（即[安装方法一：Docker镜像](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/rst_source/start/installation.html#installation-method-1-docker-image)）。 **运行简单示例：** 环境配置完成后，用户可以参照[该文档](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/rst_source/start/vla.html)的内容，运行基于ManiSkill3模拟器的具身强化学习基础示例。 **SOTA RL 训练复现：** RLinf 提供了端到端的配置和脚本，可以直接运行，无需额外工程改造，即可复现业界领先的训练效果。请参考[示例库](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/rst_source/examples/index.html)了解更多细节。 ## 基于 RLinf 的社区项目精选 我们非常高兴地看到围绕RLinf构建或集成的项目生态系统正在蓬勃发展，涵盖具身智能、机器人技术以及长时序代理系统等领域。以下是一些优秀的社区项目： - [Qwen-VLA](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-VLA): 一个统一的视觉-语言-动作模型，使用 RLinf 进行强化学习，以优化闭环任务成功率。 - [i4h-workflows](https://github.com/isaac-for-healthcare/i4h-workflows/tree/main/workflows/rheo): NVIDIA团队基于Isaac生态系统构建的强化学习工作流，集成RLinf用于面向医疗健康的具身智能研究。 - [pi-StepNFT](https://github.com/wangst0181/pi-StepNFT): 扩展RLinf以实现π系列视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的步级训练与优化。 - [Dexbotic](https://github.com/dexmal/dexbotic): 融合机器人与强化学习的系统，通过RLinf支持具身智能体的可扩展训练与部署。 - [RoboTwin](https://github.com/RoboTwin-Platform/RoboTwin): 数字孪生与机器人结合的平台，利用RLinf进行大规模具身强化学习训练。 - [IsaacLab](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/v3.0.0-EA/source/concepts/reinforcement_learning.html#rlinf-vla-post-training): 将RLinf正式整合进IsaacLab，可在基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim的机器人环境中实现无缝衔接的强化学习工作流程。 - [RISE](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/RISE): 基于组合式世界模型的机器人强化学习框架，使用 RLinf 进行在线强化学习。 💡 希望在此展示您的项目吗？欢迎提交拉取请求（PR），我们非常乐意将其收录其中！ ## 采用方（Adoption） RLinf 是一款面向具身智能、可用于生产环境的开源强化学习框架。RLinf 正在被多家企业与创业团队用于具身智能与强化学习相关的研发与落地，包括 智元机器人、自变量机器人、灵初智能、原力灵机、摩尔线程、地瓜机器人、跨维智能、华为引望、蚂蚁灵波和极佳视界等。
